narrative: Material PL1__MD24E079 exhibits smooth, high-volume daily demand averaging 1,309 units with a low CV of 0.22, making it highly predictable. Lead times, however, are unstable (CV=0.63), which is the primary driver of safety stock requirements. An (r,Q) continuous-review policy is selected: the EOQ of 15,458 units (constrained to exactly fill storage capacity) reduces annual ordering events from 45 to 22, cutting total costs by 18%. The safety stock is raised from 1,561 to 2,192 to properly cover lead-time variability at the 95% service level.
warnings: Storage capacity constraint is binding: safety_stock (2192) + order_quantity (15458) = 17650 <= max_storage_units (17650.063). Policy is feasible but at capacity limit.
Lead time CV=0.6285 classified as unstable. Supplier performance review recommended.
SAP safety lead time (4.0 days) is over-provisioned vs recommended (1.67 days).

research_insights.selection_rationale: Smooth demand (CV=0.22) with continuous positive demand makes (r,Q) the natural choice. EOQ minimizes total ordering plus holding cost; the reorder point covers mean demand during lead time plus safety stock for the 95% service level.
research_insights.boundary_risk: The storage cap of 17,650.063 units is exactly binding at peak inventory (SS=2192 + OQ=15458=17650). Any increase in safety stock or order quantity would breach capacity. If demand variability increases, the safety stock requirement may exceed available headroom, forcing a tradeoff between service level and capacity.
